title: 第十八章 名不虚传第十九章 机缘
slug: 自完美世界开始第2369章唐昊
content_zh:
馗城之外。
林阳眺望刚刚抵达此处的何九，吐出二字：“不慢。”
“阁下身法当真莫测。”
何九的浑身气机流转。
《凌波微步》用历练点修炼后便臻至化境，他近日又对《纵意登仙步》领悟更进一步，赶路之余便结合了两本功法，总结出一些独特身法技巧，结合自身之境界超过何九，他身法在赶路上不如自身也是理所应当。
“何九，持剑六派之一，东海剑庄少庄主。”
说话时，何九抬起右手，食指中指随意挥洒，剑气无形，如浪千叠，涌入茫茫之中。出手便是东海剑庄绝学《无形无相剑气》。
“江湖散修，林阳。”
心湖映射天地万物，林阳发现了几处细微的不协调之处。他踏步而出，脚踩天地之中枢，不带烟火气的避开数道飘渺不定，无形无相，不知所起，亦不知所踪的无形无相剑气。
反手拔出丹青剑，天空徒然乌云密布，电闪雷鸣。
林阳肆意大笑道：“来而不往非礼也。接我一剑。”
血液流动带起轰鸣，一缕缕神曦透体而出，更进一步的狻猊宝术化为一团雷光，覆盖丹青之上，乌云中劈来一道雷霆亦被长剑牵引，缠绕。
“就叫……天雷导我剑！”
长剑挥出，似是斩出一道雷霆，上接长空，下连大地。
何九面色沉然。整个人似是密密麻麻无数无形无相剑气组成，于千钧一发之际险之又险的躲开杀招。
抬手刚欲再次发动进攻，心中却是警兆大起，身法再展，避开威胁。
轰隆！
那一道被闪避的雷光之剑，竟是回身折返，变为一只由雷霆组成的狻猊凶兽，丝丝缕缕雷霆接连天，脚踏地。撞冲击在他刚刚站立处，引起滔天爆鸣，粉碎方圆百丈大地。
闻讯而来的一众武者之中，雄壮大汉目瞪口呆的看着这一切，木然道：“这……这真是开窍武者在交手？”
“难怪自称‘外景之下第一高手’，‘归真返璞’出手间已近乎外景。”

看着眼前仿佛天灾一般的景象，有人喃喃自语着。
“这群开窍期的怪物……”
有的人苦笑，差距太大了。
战场处。
何九面色潮红，忍不住咳出口血。哪怕第一时间远遁还是被波及到了。
“好强。”
话音未落，不可计数的无形无相剑气透体而出，似是一条无形长河冲刷向林阳，哪怕是金铁，被这条无形无相肉眼不见的剑气长河一冲，也会霎时间化作飞灰，更别说血肉之躯。
这几日间，曾有不知身份的半步外景听闻‘外景之下第一高手’之名，愤而于荒郊野外伏击林阳，被林阳反杀后，历练点用来修炼了狻猊宝术。
此刻，狻猊宝术运用的随心所欲，达到了此门宝术的至高境界。
content_en:
Outside Kuicheng.
Lin Yang looked at He Jiu who had just arrived here and uttered two words: "Not slow."
"Your body is really unpredictable."
He Jiu's whole body was filled with energy.
"Lingbo Weibu" has reached a state of perfection after practicing with experience points. Recently, he has further understood "Zongyi Ascending Immortal Steps". While on the road, he combined the two skills and summed up some unique body skills. Combined with his own realm, which surpassed He Jiu, it is natural that his body skills are not as good as his own on the road.
"He Jiu, one of the six sword-holding sects, the young master of Donghai Sword Village."
While speaking, He Jiu raised his right hand and waved his index and middle fingers freely. The sword energy was invisible, pouring into the vastness like thousands of waves. The move was Donghai Jianzhuang's secret skill "Invisible and Formless Sword Qi".
"Jianghu Loose Cultivator, Lin Yang."
The heart lake reflected everything in the world, and Lin Yang discovered several subtle incongruities. He stepped out, stepping on the center of heaven and earth, avoiding several misty, formless and formless sword energy without any smoke or fire.
He pulled out the painting sword with his backhand, but the sky was filled with dark clouds, lightning and thunder.
Lin Yang laughed wantonly and said: "It is disrespectful to come and not return. Take my sword."
The blood flow caused a roar, and wisps of divine light came out of the body. The further Suan Ni treasure technique turned into a ball of thunder, covering the painting, and a thunderbolt struck from the dark clouds and was pulled and entangled by the long sword.
"Just ask...Tian Lei to guide my sword!"
The long sword was swung out, as if it cut out a bolt of thunder, connecting up to the sky and down to the earth.
He Jiu looked solemn. The whole person seemed to be densely composed of countless invisible and formless sword energy, and he was able to dodge the killing blow at the critical moment.
He raised his hand and was about to attack again, but there was a warning sign in his heart, so he used his body skills to avoid the threat.
Boom!
The lightning sword that was dodged actually turned around and turned into a ferocious beast composed of thunder, with strands of thunder reaching the sky and touching the ground. The impact hit the place where he was just standing, causing a huge explosion and shattering the ground within a hundred feet radius.
Among the warriors who came after hearing the news, the majestic and powerful man looked at all this in stunned silence and said blankly: "This...is this really a fight between enlightened warriors?"
"No wonder he claims to be the 'number one master of outdoor scenes', and his performance of 'Returning to True Nature' is almost as good as outdoor scenes."
Looking at the scene in front of them that seemed like a natural disaster, someone murmured to themselves.
"These monsters who are in their enlightenment stage..."
Some people smiled bitterly, the gap is too big.
The battlefield.
He Jiu's face turned red and he couldn't help coughing up blood. Even if Yuan Yuan escaped immediately, he was still affected.
"So strong."
Before he finished speaking, countless invisible and formless sword energy came out of his body, like an invisible river rushing towards Lin Yang. Even gold and iron would be turned into fly ash in an instant, let alone flesh and blood, if they were washed away by this invisible, formless sword energy.
In the past few days, an unknown half-step outside scene heard the name of 'the best master in the outside scene', and angrily ambushed Lin Yang in the wilderness. After being killed by Lin Yang, he used his experience to practice the Suan Ni Treasure Technique.
At this moment, the Suani Treasure Technique can be used freely, reaching the highest level of this treasure technique.
